trap.label: make up for
trap.wrong: The great view makes up the high price.
trap.right: The great view makes up for the high price.
trap.why: Em português “compensar o preço” é transitivo direto. Em inglês, make up for é uma unidade.

mcq.q: “It makes up for its price” means...

fix.wrong: We made do of one dictionary.
fix.right: We made do with one dictionary.

fix.wrong: I could not make out the headword entry of the page.
fix.right: I could not make out the headword entry.

fix.wrong: The size makes up its price.
fix.right: The size makes up for its price.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com make do with: “They managed with one example.”
rewrite.answer: They made do with one example.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com make up for: “The view compensates the price.”
rewrite.answer: The view makes up for the price.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com make out: “I could not distinguish the words.”
rewrite.answer: I could not make out the words.
